integrity_notes: The complete finite exact-arithmetic checker is embedded in this package; its output supports the finite table, and an independent diagonal-dominance argument proves the infinite tail.
scientific_limitations: Ranks are for the precise normalized 48-point binary octahedral (F4-root) configuration, not perturbations or arbitrary spherical point sets. No singular-value estimates or full kernel bases are provided. Originality comparison is bounded, with representation-theoretic coverage a residual risk.
title: All-degree spherical-harmonic sampling ranks on the normalized \(F_4\) root system
